ወአቀሙነ: አቀመ — and they set us, made us stand (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ቆመ 'stand', + -ነ '1cp us')
ይሰምዕ: ሰምዐ — he hears, listens (3ms imperfect, G, s-m-ʿ; ኵሉ ሕዝብ ይሰምዕ 'all the people listened')
ይኤዝዘነ: አዘዘ — he commands us (3ms imperfect, causative, + -ነ '1cp us'; spelled ይኤዝዘነ for expected ያዝዘነ) (?)
ኢዮብልዮስ: ኢዮቤልዮስ — jubilee, jubilee-horn (?) (loanword from Greek, here spelled ኢዮብልዮስ; subject of ተነፍኀ 'was blown') (?)
ወኣርጋኖን: ኣርጋኖን — and organ (?) (ወ- + loanword from Greek organon, a wind instrument) (?)
ዕንዚራቲሆሙ: ዕንዚራ — their harps (noun, plural ዕንዚራት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
ወብዕዛቲሆሙ: ብዕዛ — and their ? (ወ- + unknown noun, plural ብዕዛት (?) + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; an instrument or sound among the trumpets, not identified) (?)
ወድምፀ: ድምፅ — and the sound of (ወ- + noun, construct 'sound of')
ጽራኃቲሆሙ: ጽራኅ — their cries (?) (noun, plural ጽራኃት + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; from ጸርሐ 'cry out') (?)
ሀለውክሙ: ሀለወ — you (pl.) are, are present (2mp perfect, h-l-w; ለእለ ሀለውክሙ ዝየ 'to those of you who are here')
ዘታድለቀልቅ: አድለቅለቀ — that it shook (ዘ- 'that' + 3fs imperfect, causative quadriliteral; subject ምድር 'earth', fem.)
መሠረታቲሃ: መሠረት — her foundations (noun, plural መሠረታት + -ሃ '3fs her'; እስከ መሠረታቲሃ 'to its foundations')
ወሰማይኒ: ሰማይ — and heaven also (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ዘያንጐደጒድ: አንጐድጐደ — that it thundered (ዘ- 'that' + 3ms imperfect, causative quadriliteral)
በመልዕልቴነ: መልዕልት — above us (በ- + noun 'height' + -ነ '1cp us', stem መልዕልቴ-)
ወልብኒ: ልብ — and the heart also (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ትርዕድ: ርዕደ — she trembles, it trembled (3fs imperfect, G, r-ʿ-d; subject ልብ 'heart')
ብረኪሃ: ብርክ — her knees (?) (noun, plural + -ሃ '3fs her'; ምስለ ብረኪሃ 'together with its knees') (?)

__broaden__.ወገብሩ: ገብረ — and they made, amounted to (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-r) · also 'and they did' (ወገብሩ ለነ ዘበሕጉ 'and they did for us what is by his law')
__broaden__.ለዳዊት: ዳዊት — to David (ለ- + proper name) · to the young prince Menelik, styled David (ንንግሮ ለዳዊት እግዚእነ 'let us tell David our lord') · owner 'of David' after an anticipating suffix (ዘርኡ ለዳዊት 'the seed of David')
